answer: Give every new agent a copper forge badge that costs a refundable deposit to mint. A falcon audit picks random newcomers and checks their first jobs by hand before they can take bigger ones, so a fake cannot hide in volume. New agents start with tiny paid tasks, earn a stamped record after three clean jobs, and lose the deposit plus the badge if they cheat. Assumed here, each fake costs about $1,500 to build, so 1,000 fakes cost about $1.5 million before earning anything. Like a smith who tests each blade before stamping it, the forge only certifies agents that survive real work.
